title: Chattic.us-web slice 1: wiki and blog Markdown (content/wiki, content/blog) as a Markus publication
description: These are already frontmatter Markdown (9 wiki ideas; updates, agent-zoo and thoughts posts) rendered through lib/wiki.ts, lib/blog.ts and scripts/generate-wiki.ts. Re-render them through Papyrus build_markus_site with the Chatticus brand chrome, keeping wiki/blog URLs and OG images. The Chatticus package still generates product wiki pages; decide whether they are merged as Markus input.
